text:
maria: Heads up — RC for 0.18.0 is blocked. typegen diff popped up for js-sdk after regen; sample-kit onboarding CI failing. Anyone taking a look?
ben: Link to CI?
maria: https://ci.internal/redwood/17385 (failing job 4)
maria: Failure snippet:
```
Error: type-hash mismatch
- export interface CreateWidget { name: string; description?: string; tags?: string[] }
+ export interface CreateWidget { description?: string; name: string; tags?: string[] }
```
ben: Looks like OpenAPI property ordering changed. typegen picks up different field order -> type-hash changed. Two quick levers: sort properties in codegen or pin the typegen generator version we used previously.
rachel: Also: semver guard blocked the release earlier because changelog said "minor" features. If we do a patch to fix ordering, the semver check won't let us publish patch because changelog claims minor. We can either adjust changelog (not ideal) or make a small PR that both regenerates types and updates changelog to be accurate.
ci-bot: publish-gate: release blocked by metadata mismatch (typehash != expected). See https://ci.internal/reports/17385/summary
ben: I can open a quick PR: plan -> 1) run local regen with stable-sort flag, 2) run sample-kit smoke, 3) update package.json/type-hash, 4) add a short changelog clarification (turn the "minor" note into "patch: internal SDK parity fix") so semver checks pass.
maria: Can we avoid editing the spec itself? Last time we did spec edits and downstream owners got surprised.
ben: Yep, no spec change. Just set codegen config: `--sort-properties true` (or set generator config to stableSort=true). That should reorder generated types deterministically.
rachel: Ok but please make changelog note explicit about why the patch is needed (sdk parity). We don't want product to think new user-facing feature shipped.
ben: Will do. I'll also run `yarn sample-kit:test` locally before pushing. Command I'll run: `yarn tools:typegen --openapi=./openapi/widget.yaml --stable-sort && yarn sample-kit:test`.
dev-tools-bot: Noted and queued: when PR is opened, automatic typehash check will re-run. Add release milestone: 0.18.0-rc1-fix.
maria: Thanks Ben — can you tag @rachel when PR is up so we can confirm changelog wording? Also ping #release-war-room once CI is green. :thumbsup:
ben: Opening PR in ~12m, will include CI log and before/after diff.
rachel: If CI still flakes, we may need temporary release-exception from release-ops, but let's avoid that.
ci-bot: build triggered by ben/patch-regen (job 4 queued).
maria: Appreciate it — let's keep the release momentum.
